name: Stack
description: Stacks children in a row or column with one consistent gap.

gap.description: Space between children on the layout gap scale: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24

divided.description: Draw a Separator between children: horizontal in a column, vertical in a row. Inside ul/ol each divider is a hidden li, so the list stays valid. Ignored when collapseBelow is set.

collapseBelow.description: A CSS length. Children share the row in equal parts while the Stack is at least this wide and stack into a column below it. Measured against the Stack's own width, never the viewport. Implies a row.

when: Spacing a short row or column of elements
A row that should fold into a column when its pane gets narrow (collapseBelow)
whenNot: Grouping buttons into one control (use ButtonGroup)
guidelines: Set gap once on the parent instead of margins on children
gap reads the one layout scale; there is no numeric second scale
collapseBelow answers the Stack's own width, so it holds inside panes, cards and dialogs
Use as="nav" or as="ul" so the markup stays semantic
divided draws one Separator between children; lists stay valid
accessibility: Use semantic elements (nav, section, etc.) via "as" prop
Maintains source order for screen readers
No accessibility concerns with visual arrangement

examples.name: Vertical Stack
examples.description: Children flow top to bottom — the default.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

<Stack gap="sm">
  <Text>One</Text>
  <Text>Two</Text>
  <Text>Three</Text>
</Stack>

examples.name: Horizontal Stack
examples.description: Children flow along the inline axis.

examples.name: Collapse Below
examples.description: Side by side while the Stack is at least 32rem wide, a column below that.
examples.code:
import { Field } from '@/components/Field';
import { Input } from '@/components/Input';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack collapseBelow="32rem" gap="md">
  <Field>
    <Field.Label>First name</Field.Label>
    <Input />
  </Field>
  <Field>
    <Field.Label>Last name</Field.Label>
    <Input />
  </Field>
</Stack>

examples.name: Divided
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';
import { Text } from '@/components/Text';

<Stack gap="md" divided>
  <Text>Section one</Text>
  <Text>Section two</Text>
  <Text>Section three</Text>
</Stack>
